public_rationale: At launch, Google and the independent evaluator Artificial Analysis both showed Gemini 3 Pro at or near the top of most major benchmarks. That includes first place on LMArena and on Artificial Analysis's overall index. Google described it as its 'most intelligent model', not as AGI. Google DeepMind's CEO later said the field is 'still not there' on AGI. No credible source treated Gemini 3 as AGI. 'Great model' is an opinion and is not scored.
limitations: 'AGI' has no agreed definition; the 'not AGI' part is supported by consensus rather than a measurement.
The CEO statement is dated February 2026, after the target period, so it serves as context.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Gemini 3 is a great LLM that tops most benchmarks but is certainly not AGI.

criteria.support_condition: Launch-time results show Gemini 3 first on most benchmarks, and no credible source, Google included, treats it as AGI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Gemini 3 led only a minority of benchmarks, or credible evidence shows it met a reasonable definition of AGI.

evidence.excerpt: It tops the LMArena Leaderboard with a breakthrough score of 1501 Elo. It demonstrates PhD-level reasoning with top scores on Humanity’s Last Exam (37.5% without the usage of any tools) and GPQA Diamond (91.9%).
evidence.locator: section 'State-of-the-art reasoning with unprecedented depth and nuance', paragraph 2
evidence.explanation: Shows Gemini 3 Pro at or near the top of major benchmarks at launch.

evidence.excerpt: The model outperforms all other models in Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. It demonstrates strength across the board, coming in first in 5 of the 10 evaluations that make up Intelligence Index.
evidence.explanation: Independent confirmation that Gemini 3 Pro led overall at launch, though it led only half of the component evals.

evidence.excerpt: Demis Hassabis, Chief Executive Officer of Google DeepMind, said the world is “still not there” when it comes to artificial general intelligence (AGI), describing current AI systems as powerful but inconsistent and limited.
evidence.explanation: Months after Gemini 3 launched, Google DeepMind's own CEO said AGI had not been reached. This backs the 'not AGI' part, though it is dated after the target period.
